spec: DACS-4 §9.5.9 DEM-1..DEM-7; DEMOS-MAPPING §A.2 native-send record profile; §9.5.1 PC-4/PC-7; §9.5.8 SB-2; §9.7.0 FV-5
description: Inclusion does not prove execution. Only a getTxByHash record from a pinned node that decodes under the native-send record profile and binds the retained hash, nonce, block, sender, recipient and OS amount with status confirmed succeeds; a bound failed record is a permanent failure; anything else is a substrate result without a second broadcast.

demosProfile.liveObservations: node2-* vectors copy read-only node2.demos.sh getTxByHash responses of 2026-10-17; the node reported 61b8e75 with a dirty tree, so they are observations, not the source pin

fixtureVocabulary.statusIndex: getTransactionStatus state for the retained hash (included, pending or unknown); never decisive
fixtureVocabulary.inclusionObservation: block identified for the retained hash, or null
fixtureVocabulary.recordRead: getTxByHash read: found (with the record and whether the node is pinned to the profile), not-found (the node's error result) or unavailable
fixtureVocabulary.otherGates: verdicts of the FV, SB-1 and PB checks that compose with DEM-7 before delivery
fixtureVocabulary.consumerAdmissions: (jobId, phaseIndex) tuples for which this consumer already admitted the same demos:{txHash}
fixtureVocabulary.guards: checks whose removal makes this vector fail

vectors.name: included-confirmed
vectors.note: A bound confirmed record in the node's wire form is the only success.

vectors.name: node2-confirmed-record
vectors.note: A live node2 getTxByHash record (string nonce, numeric amount, 0x parties, unprefixed send argument) binds after projection.

vectors.name: confirmed-integer-nonce-binds
vectors.note: A safe JSON integer nonce projects to the same signed nonce.

vectors.name: confirmed-large-string-amount-binds
vectors.note: Above 2^53 - 1 OS the node serves the amount as a decimal string; it binds by integer value.

vectors.name: confirmed-unprefixed-parties-bind
vectors.note: A party key without the 0x prefix projects to the same DACS-1 key.

vectors.name: included-failed
vectors.note: Included is not executed: a bound failed record is a durable permanent failure with no replacement.

vectors.name: node2-included-failed-record
vectors.note: A live node2 transfer whose status index said included while its record failed (TX_NONCE_INVALID_LOW).

vectors.name: included-pending
vectors.note: Included with a pending record is unresolved: substrate, re-read only.

vectors.name: included-record-not-found
vectors.note: Included but no record for the retained hash: execution is unknown and nothing is resent.

vectors.name: included-record-unavailable
vectors.note: An unreachable node leaves execution unknown; no success, failure or delivery.

vectors.name: included-alias
vectors.note: A record status copied from the index label is not an execution result.

vectors.name: finalized-alias
vectors.note: Finality vocabulary is not the executed record status.

vectors.name: success-alias
vectors.note: Only the exact Demos record status confirmed establishes execution.

vectors.name: confirmed-case-variant
vectors.note: Status comparison is exact; a case variant is unknown.

vectors.name: confirmed-unpinned-node
vectors.note: A node not pinned to the profile's execution-record semantics may store a failed transfer as confirmed.

vectors.name: failed-unpinned-node
vectors.note: A failed record from an unpinned node proves nothing about execution either.

vectors.name: confirmed-wrong-hash
vectors.note: A confirmed record for another hash says nothing about the retained transfer.

vectors.name: confirmed-wrong-nonce
vectors.note: A record whose nonce differs from the signed nonce is unbound.

vectors.name: confirmed-wrong-block
vectors.note: A record in a different block from the inclusion observation is unbound.

vectors.name: confirmed-wrong-sender
vectors.note: A record debiting another sender is unbound.

vectors.name: confirmed-wrong-recipient
vectors.note: A record paying another recipient is unbound.

vectors.name: confirmed-wrong-amount
vectors.note: A record for a different OS amount is unbound.

vectors.name: confirmed-missing-nonce
vectors.note: A record missing its nonce does not decode.

vectors.name: confirmed-boolean-nonce
vectors.note: true is not a nonce, even when the signed nonce is 1.

vectors.name: confirmed-fractional-nonce
vectors.note: A non-integer number does not decode as a nonce.

vectors.name: confirmed-leading-zero-nonce
vectors.note: A decimal string with a leading zero is not canonical.

vectors.name: confirmed-fractional-amount
vectors.note: A non-integer amount is not an OS amount.

vectors.name: confirmed-noncanonical-amount
vectors.note: A decimal amount string with a leading zero is not canonical.

vectors.name: confirmed-prefixed-hash
vectors.note: The Demos hash is 64 lowercase hex digits without 0x.

vectors.name: confirmed-uppercase-sender
vectors.note: A party key with uppercase hex does not decode.

vectors.name: confirmed-sender-alias-mismatch
vectors.note: from and from_ed25519_address must name the same key.

vectors.name: confirmed-payload-recipient-mismatch
vectors.note: The native send argument must credit the same recipient as content.to.

vectors.name: confirmed-payload-amount-mismatch
vectors.note: The native send argument must carry the same OS amount as content.amount.

vectors.name: confirmed-not-native-send
vectors.note: Only a native send moves the payment.

vectors.name: confirmed-without-inclusion-observation
vectors.note: Without an inclusion observation the record's block cannot be bound.

vectors.name: failed-wrong-nonce
vectors.note: A failed record with another nonce does not prove this transfer failed.

vectors.name: failed-missing-nonce
vectors.note: A failed record missing its nonce does not decode, so it proves nothing.

vectors.name: failed-wrong-block
vectors.note: A failed record in another block conflicts with the inclusion observation.

vectors.name: failed-wrong-amount
vectors.note: A failed record for another amount does not prove this transfer failed.

vectors.name: failed-wrong-hash
vectors.note: A failed record for another hash does not prove this transfer failed.

vectors.name: failed-wrong-sender
vectors.note: A failed record from another sender does not prove this transfer failed.

vectors.name: failed-wrong-recipient
vectors.note: A failed record to another recipient does not prove this transfer failed.

vectors.name: failed-without-inclusion-observation
vectors.note: A failed record without an inclusion observation is not a bound failure.

vectors.name: transfer-unknown-not-rebroadcast
vectors.note: The node's status index says unknown and there is no record; the handler still only re-reads.

vectors.name: resume-reuses-failure-proof
vectors.note: A resume after a proven failure reuses it even while the node is unreachable.

vectors.name: resume-corrupted-failure-proof
vectors.note: A retained proof whose nonce no longer binds is not reused; re-read only.

vectors.name: resume-corrupted-failure-proof-recipient
vectors.note: A retained proof for another recipient is not reused.

vectors.name: resume-corrupted-failure-proof-block
vectors.note: A retained proof whose record is in another block than its inclusion block is not reused.

vectors.name: resume-corrupted-failure-proof-status
vectors.note: A retained proof whose record is not failed is not a failure proof.

vectors.name: resume-without-proof-not-found
vectors.note: A crash after a possible broadcast resumes by re-reading, never resending.

vectors.name: resume-without-proof-confirmed
vectors.note: Re-reading the retained hash finds the executed transfer; no second payment.

vectors.name: first-broadcast-after-durable-retention
vectors.note: The single broadcast is allowed once the signed transfer is durably retained for this phase.

vectors.name: broadcast-before-durable-retention
vectors.note: Volatile retention cannot support recovery, so the broadcast is refused.

vectors.name: broadcast-with-incomplete-retention
vectors.note: A retained transfer without its signed nonce is structurally incomplete.

vectors.name: broadcast-with-retention-missing-recipient
vectors.note: A retained transfer without its recipient is structurally incomplete.

vectors.name: broadcast-with-retention-missing-phase
vectors.note: A retained transfer not keyed to a phase index is structurally incomplete.

vectors.name: broadcast-with-ill-typed-retained-amount
vectors.note: The retained OS amount is a canonical decimal string.

vectors.name: second-broadcast-refused
vectors.note: The same signed bytes are not sent again once they may have been broadcast.

vectors.name: replacement-broadcast-refused
vectors.note: A replacement transfer is never sent for the same job phase.

vectors.name: broadcast-retained-for-another-job
vectors.note: A transfer retained for another job cannot pay this phase.

vectors.name: broadcast-retained-for-another-phase
vectors.note: A transfer retained for another phase index of the same job cannot pay this phase.

vectors.name: broadcast-from-another-paying-key
vectors.note: A transfer signed by a key other than payer.payingKey is refused, even when retained consistently.

vectors.name: broadcast-to-another-destination
vectors.note: A transfer to a destination other than payee.payeeAddress is refused, even when retained consistently.

vectors.name: broadcast-of-another-amount
vectors.note: A transfer of an amount other than the phase amount in OS is refused.

vectors.name: broadcast-signed-nonce-differs
vectors.note: The retained nonce must be the nonce the payer signed.

vectors.name: broadcast-signed-sender-differs
vectors.note: An authentic transfer from another key must not replace the retained payer transfer.

vectors.name: broadcast-signed-recipient-differs
vectors.note: Signed bytes that pay another destination than the retained recipient are refused.

vectors.name: broadcast-signed-amount-differs
vectors.note: Signed bytes for another amount than the retained OS amount are refused.

vectors.name: broadcast-signed-hash-differs
vectors.note: The retained hash must be the hash of the signed transaction.

vectors.name: broadcast-signed-pre-fork-amount
vectors.note: A send signed in the pre-osDenomination form (numeric amount argument) does not decode, so it is never broadcast.

vectors.name: broadcast-signed-uppercase-recipient
vectors.note: demosdk accepts an upper-case recipient, but it does not decode under the profile, so it is never broadcast.

vectors.name: broadcast-unsigned-transaction
vectors.note: A claimed transaction without the payer's signature is not a signed transfer.

vectors.name: broadcast-hash-not-over-content
vectors.note: A hash and signature made over other content (here another nonce) do not commit to the content retained.

vectors.name: broadcast-signed-by-another-key
vectors.note: A signature by a key other than content.from does not authenticate the payer's transfer.

vectors.name: broadcast-signature-type-not-ed25519
vectors.note: Only an ed25519 signature by the sender key is verified under the profile.

vectors.name: broadcast-hash-retained-for-another-phase
vectors.note: One signed transfer cannot be retained for, and pay, two phases.

vectors.name: consumer-confirmed-gate-passes
vectors.note: A bound confirmed record passes DEM-7 only; it authorizes no delivery by itself.

vectors.name: consumer-node2-confirmed-gate-passes
vectors.note: The live node2 confirmed record binds to its evidence and phase after projection.

vectors.name: consumer-included-only-refused
vectors.note: An included label without a record is not admitted as payment.

vectors.name: consumer-pending-refused
vectors.note: A pending record is not admitted as payment.

vectors.name: consumer-unavailable-refused
vectors.note: An unreachable node supplies no execution result.

vectors.name: consumer-finalized-alias-refused
vectors.note: Only the exact confirmed status is admitted.

vectors.name: consumer-success-alias-refused
vectors.note: The fixture-codec word success is not a Demos record status.

vectors.name: consumer-case-variant-refused
vectors.note: Status comparison is exact for consumers too.

vectors.name: consumer-unpinned-node-refused
vectors.note: A confirmed record from a node without the pinned execution-record semantics is not admitted.

vectors.name: consumer-failed-fails
vectors.note: A bound failed record refutes the success evidence.

vectors.name: consumer-wrong-payee-unauthenticated
vectors.note: An unauthenticated read that pays another payee does not satisfy DEM-7.

vectors.name: consumer-wrong-block-unauthenticated
vectors.note: An unauthenticated read in another block does not satisfy DEM-7.

vectors.name: consumer-wrong-payer-unauthenticated
vectors.note: An unauthenticated read from another payer does not satisfy DEM-7.

vectors.name: consumer-wrong-amount-authenticated
vectors.note: Under FV-5 an authenticated record for another amount is fail.

vectors.name: consumer-wrong-payee-authenticated
vectors.note: Under FV-5 an authenticated record paying another payee is fail.

vectors.name: delivery-after-all-gates
vectors.note: A bound confirmed record, FV-5-authenticated, with SB-1, SB-2 and PB passing, authorizes delivery.

vectors.name: delivery-record-unauthenticated
vectors.note: A bound confirmed record from a plain RPC read is not BFT-final proof; no delivery.

vectors.name: delivery-dem7-pending
vectors.note: FV, SB and PB passing do not replace an executed record.

vectors.name: delivery-fv-indeterminate
vectors.note: Without verified BFT finality the confirmed record authorizes nothing.

vectors.name: delivery-sb1-fails
vectors.note: A confirmed transfer cited under another anchor tuple is rejected by SB-1.

vectors.name: delivery-pb-fails
vectors.note: A confirmed transfer to a destination outside the agreement is rejected by PB.

vectors.name: delivery-hash-admitted-for-another-job
vectors.note: pay-dem has no settlement-side job binding: a demos:{txHash} the payee already admitted for another job makes the group indeterminate.

vectors.name: delivery-hash-admitted-for-another-phase
vectors.note: The same collision rule applies to another phase index of the same job.

vectors.name: delivery-same-tuple-readmitted
vectors.note: Re-presenting the same evidence for the same tuple is idempotent.
